label: A total cause of a thing's being r has at least as high a represented degree of r as the thing
paraphrase: Analyst formulation of 'at least as much reality in the efficient and total cause as in its effect' on a represented degree (navigation: Descartes, Meditation III; attribution deferred): for a degree assignment deg : R → B → D in a preorder, whenever c is the efficient and total cause of x's being r, deg r x ≤ deg r c. Stated per respect: an analyst generalization of Descartes's single overall degree of reality, of which the instance at esse is the closest reading. It uses the represented degree family (DEF-PER-RESPECT-DEGREE-FAMILY), not the MORE_2 comparative itself: it is the non-strict counterpart of MORE_2, and '≤' is 'at least as much', not merely 'not exceeded'. Open.
